description: The kit's users banner: run by users-probe.mjs while stored users don't match the server (a restored data folder, the reconciler's guard tripped). As admin, GET /Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics has the Users entry with the banner, and Bookmarks' settings page shows the banner as a warning (an amber bar and tint) at its top, above the settings, and the unknown users' line in its Diagnostics section, as text. No user names are shown there.

steps.name: the Users entry: the guard's banner
steps.assert: (u => !!u && u.StoredUsersMismatch === true && /^Stored users don't match this server/.test(u.Banner) && /unknown users\.$/.test(u.Message) && u.DeletedUserPolicy === 'KeepAsOrphan')(__vars.diagnostics.Users)

steps.name: the page has the banner, and Diagnostics loaded
the banner, as plain text, an alert
steps.assert: (b => b.textContent.startsWith("Stored users don't match this server; was data restored from another server? Nothing was changed.") && b.textContent === __vars.diagnostics.Users.Banner && b.children.length === 0 && b.getAttribute('role') === 'alert')(document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide) .bookmarksUsersBanner'))

steps.name: styled as a warning, above the settings form
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const b = p.querySelector('.bookmarksUsersBanner'); const cs = getComputedStyle(b); return cs.borderLeftStyle === 'solid' && cs.borderLeftColor === 'rgb(240, 173, 78)' && !!(b.compareDocumentPosition(p.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigForm')) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING); })()

steps.name: the unknown users' line in Diagnostics, as text
steps.assert: !__vars.summary.includes("Stored users don't match") && /\d+ records belong to \d+ unknown users\. Deleted-user policy: KeepAsOrphan\./.test(__vars.summary)

steps.name: open the Diagnostics tab and scroll to it
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider as the page is left, excepted)
